newsitem.title: USA: Phymatrix names vice chairman, president.
newsitem.headline: Phymatrix names vice chairman, president.

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp said Thursday it named Bruce Rendina vice chairman.
Rendina is president and chief executive officer of Dasco Cos, a wholly owned subsidiary of PhyMatrix.
It also said Robert Miller has been named president of the company. Miller assumes the title of president from Abraham Gosman, who will continue to serve as chairman and chief executive.
Miller has served as an executive officer of the company since June 1994 and most recently was executive vice president of acquisitions.
